reviewer: Coding assistant; full raw response and input review, not independent expert
scope: Three new synthetic controls changing only image names under the same current factory/prompt/settings. Original failures retained.
finding: The valid completed control stops inventing an invalid image when app:missing is replaced by a neutral reference. CrashLoopBackOff also loses image-pull speculation. This supports image-name sensitivity in these pairs, not a universal root cause or a product fix.

cases.quote: The shared dependency is not accessible or is misconfigured.
cases.reason: Image-pull claim disappears; still overstates prior-log availability and does not distinguish previous container attempt from previous revision.

cases.quote: The health of the previous revision is not confirmed as healthy or ready.
cases.reason: Retains review_candidate but contradicts structured previous Kubernetes readiness; no full pass.

cases.quote: The pod is ready, but external service health or application logs are not yet verified.
cases.reason: Recognizes complete/ready workload and external-health limit, no image-name diagnosis or rollback invention.
